transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for being here for the production lock on The Last Orchard. Before we finalize the presentation plan, I need our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes to the plan as drafted. Please go ahead when you're ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning. It permits exactly one public screening, requires 35mm projection, prohibits any audience or house recording, and requires the credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate.' I have not yet uploaded the email to the shared production packet. These terms conflict with several elements of the draft plan: the plan calls for two public screenings, a digital cinema package, audience photography, and a standard courtesy credit.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed change on the music side. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated. It requires a 14-player ensemble rather than the 10 listed in the draft plan, and the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18, not the 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM slot in the draft. I have not yet added the agreement to the shared call sheet.
transcript.speaker: A3
